newsitem.title: LATVIA: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 24.
newsitem.headline: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Radio Latvia on Thursday at mid-day. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- The Union of Christian Democrats says the current goverment crises sparked by anti-corruption scandals might be followed by a parliamentary crises as one fifth of the 100-seat parliament is also under investigation on similar charges.
- Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs, head of the Latvia's Way party, said the government rescue plan offered by Prime minister Andris Shkele is not a long-term solution to the current problems.
The party will not nominate a new transport post candidate until its decides whether to continue its participation in the current government.
